text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: routing.service.p99_latency breached (3.1s) for /v1/generate — router-lb cluster east-us-2. Auto-escalation to oncall.jamie sent.

pagerduty: Pager: oncall.jamie — High p99 on router-lb; runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/router-p99 (priority: P1)

jamie: acked — I'm on it. grabbing baseline metrics, will post p95/p99 and affected regions.

jamie: p95=420ms, p99=3.1s (rolling 5m). Streaming stalls reported in traces — downstream stream chunks delayed >2s. Errors: 502/504 spike ~0.8% (normally 0.02%).

li (eng-runtime): saw correlated increase in handoffs from router->lb at ~1730UTC. routing-policy rollout completed ~30m ago (weight smoothing + zone-failover heuristics). suspicious: a policy path returns a stale shard map and pushes to a smaller hotset.

meera (eng-sre): confirmed tail latency concentrated in east-us-2 and eu-west-1 (zone skew). heatmap attached in ops dash (link). Hot partitioning on router shards 12-14 — consistent with a hotkey amplification pattern.

sam (eng-runtime): streaming stalls look like KV cache thrash on serving nodes; when a token fetch misses, tail fanout hits backend and stalls stream. if router misroutes to overloaded pool, that amplifies.

jamie: immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert routing policy to previous stable (rollback ID: rp-2026-04-29) 2) fail traffic off east-us-2 to standby region 3) enable aggressive prefix cache eviction on affected pools 4) notify customers. executing 1 now.

dawn (infra): running rollback command:
```
# rollback routing policy
redwoodctl routing policies rollback --policy-id rp-2026-05-02 --to rp-2026-04-29 --cluster router-lb
```
Applying to router-lb/east-us-2 and router-lb/eu-west-1. ETA ~40s per zone.

eng-runtime: also pushing a temporary override to weight routes (manual) — moving 40% traffic off east-us-2 to east-us-1:
```
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "overrides": [{"region":"east-us-2","weight":0.6},{"region":"east-us-1","weight":0.4}],
  "reason": "mitigate hot partitioning after routing policy regression"
}
```
Applied via admin API.

incident-bot: runbook step executed: rollback started by dawn (dawn@infra). Notifying on-call rotation.

jamie: observing metrics: p99 dropping from 3.1s -> 920ms within 2min after override, streaming stalls decreased but some client-side timeouts persisted.

meera: customer impact assessment: two enterprise customers (cust-A, cust-B) reported degraded latency and intermittent 502s for ~12-20 minutes. No data exfiltration. Logging retention increased for these tenants for postmortem.

sam: digging into logs — top 5 hotkeys on affected shards are noisy (user IDs repeated in tens of thousands of requests). Excerpt:
```
hotkey-stats:
  shard-12: user:U12345 -> 23k reqs/min
  shard-13: user:U98765 -> 18k reqs/min
```
Suggest we add short-term rate-limit per-key and longer-term hotspots mitigation.

li: confirmed a subtle ordering bug in the new smoothing logic — when weight decay hits 0 for a node, routing falls back to hash-only path that neglected zone weight normalization, causing a concentration on a sub-pool. I'll open a revert PR and post fix.

jamie: ticket created: INC-2026-1887, and followup bug: BUG-2026-4023. Adding owners: @li, @sam, @meera.

dawn: manual traffic shift complete for east-us-2 -> east-us-1. Metrics now: p95=380ms, p99=510ms, errors down to 0.06%.

nate: taking over from jamie for next 2 hours (handoff). jamie handing off with notes: rollback applied, weights adjusted, KV cache eviction in progress, followups: rate-limit hotkeys, patch smoothing logic.

jamie: handing off — I will stay reachable for escalation. please keep incident channel updated with any regression.

postmortem-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1887 — Severity: Sev2 -> will upgrade if customers report more impact. Postmortem template posted to #postmortems.

meera: action items summary: [1] rate-limit and throttle hotkeys (sam), [2] patch routing smoothing bug (li), [3] improved canary checks for routing policy rollouts (eng-runtime), [4] add automated fallback that respects zone-normalized weights (infra/runtime).

sam: running short-term rule to cap per-key qps to 50 for the hot keys. applied via edge rate limiter.

li: PR for revert+fix incoming in ~1h; will include unit tests for zone normalization.

jamie: customer comms: sent initial note to account teams for cust-A/cust-B. will send summary later.

nate: monitoring: set temporary alert for routing.service.p99 > 700ms to catch any regression during rollback window.

jamie: closing primary mitigation — marking incident as mitigated. leaving channel open for follow-up and postmortem. great run everyone. :raised_hands:

incident-bot: Mitigation confirmed at 1887654721. Duration: ~13 minutes to initial mitigation. Next steps: postmortem, followup tickets, release block on routing policy rollouts until canary improved.

postmortem-bot: Postmortem skeleton: https://redwood/postmortems/INC-2026-1887 — please populate timeline and RCA sections.

nate: handoff complete — logging handover note in incident doc.

jamie: thanks — ending active page.
